command: set -e; echo SERVER_HEALTH_START; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo USER=$(id -un); echo UID=$(id -u); echo PWD=$(pwd); echo KERNEL=$(uname -sr); echo ARCH=$(uname -m); echo UPTIME=$(uptime -p); echo DISK=$(df -h /opt/madworld | awk 'NR==2{print $5 "," $4 " free"}'); echo MEMORY=$(free -h | awk '/Mem:/{print $7 " available"}'); echo OPERATOR=$(systemctl is-active madworld-remote-operator.service); echo OPERATOR_ENABLED=$(systemctl is-enabled madworld-remote-operator.service); echo SYNC_TIMER=$(systemctl is-active madworld-remote-operator-sync.timer); echo SYNC_ENABLED=$(systemctl is-enabled madworld-remote-operator-sync.timer); echo FAILED_UNITS=$(systemctl --failed --no-legend | wc -l); echo SERVER_HEALTH_OK
